body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Tiny commander with enormous confidence; spirited short declarations, never genuinely aggressive. Voice direction: Brassy upper male register with precise English pronunciation. Brisk clipped declarations, springy energy and absurdly assured confidence. A small voice with enormous presence, without shouting. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Hold that position! The defender moves, and the piece is lost. Check the reply first; a confident move still needs a solid reason.
